class_imbalance_treatment: No resampling or class reweighting in the binary models; Random Forest uses balanced_subsample as specified in model code. Multiclass XGBoost uses no class weighting or resampling.
calibration: Sigmoid calibration fitted on a held-out subset of the original fitting partition; independent test used only for final evaluation.

xai_protocol.selection: stratified sample from independent test partition using fixed seed

heterogeneous_impact: Illustrative port/service proxy tiers 1.00, 0.75, 0.50, 0.25; not observed asset criticality.
scenario_aggregation: 1-product(1-p_i), conditional independence assumption; batch-level only, not horizon likelihood.
NBE_directive: SBB/83/2022; clause-level mapping is an alignment aid, not a compliance opinion.
